Power

 Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the 
major maintenance procedures P1, which must be performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the above title block.
Deluge valve is open to allow passing water to mixing with 
foam through ejector if two fire detectors operate at 90 C
The first draft initiated by eng. Ali Fahmy, revised by EDEPC inspection 
& quality control eng. Abouda Elbana, eng. Medhat Khater and tested by eng. Abd Elhamid Abu Zaid, approved by 
eng. Mohamed Gouda; Port Said Gas Turbine Power Station Director, and certified 
by eng. Aly Mostafa El Lethy; EDEPC inspection & quality control Head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued, 
the qualified maintenance staff should
 carry the suitable safety category,
Wear your safety helmet, 
 safety shoes, eye glass, nose mouth "dust cover" .... etc
Close the water supply 
 line-isolating valve.
Disconnect the DC power from 
 solenoid valve.
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Safety and healthy equipment
Rags.
Work to be Carried out
Remove 
 the restrictor orifice (part #1 Drw 1) and check its cleaning.
Clean the 
 1/4 inch "Y" strainer (part # 3 Drw 1) located in the 1/4 priming by-pass line 
 to remove any accumulated sediment.
Inspect the valve seat if a continuous flow of water 
 from the inch ball drip valve (part # 6 Drw 1) is observed following this procedure.
Valve 
Disassembly
Close the main shut off valve 
 (part # 7 
 Figure 
 1)
Close the inch valve (part 
 # 2 
 Figure 
 1)
Open main drain valve (part 
 # 5 
 Figure 
 1) 
 to drain system piping
Open manual emergency station 
 model (DL -- A) to drain
Drain pilot sprinkler
Open inch water flow test 
 valve (part # 4 
 Figure 
 1) 
 to relieve
Water pressure in lower 
 chamber
Remove the deluge valve cover
Lift the diaphragm piston 
 assembly out of the valve.
Valve Inspection and Repair
Inspect the valve seat (Part # 4 
 Figure 2) for irregularities and remove any foreign substance, clean the valve seat if any
Grind the valve seat with grinding paste if any scratches are observed on 
 the seat
Inspect rubber seal (Part # 7 
 Figure 2) and replace it if any sign of wear is noticed
Inspect the neoprene diaphragm (Part 
 #6 
 Figure 2) and replace it if it is cracked or shows signs of wear
Valve 
Re-assembly
Assemble the neoprene 
 diaphragm (Part # 6 Figure 2).
Assemble the rubber seal (Part # 7 
 Figure 
 2).
Assemble the valve diaphragm 
 piston set
Assemble the Valve Cover 
(Part #2 
 Figure 2)
Start 
 the system before the system the following steps must be checked:-
Close inch 
 water flow test valve (part # 4 
 Figure 1).
Close manual 
 emergency station valve model (DL-A).
Close main 
 drain valve (Part 
 # 5 
 Figure 1).
Open the 
 inch valve (Part 
 # 2 
 Figure 1).
Open the 
 main shut-off valve (Part # 7 
 Figure 1).
Attendance and Checking During Operation
Check for any 
leakage in the system.
Check the water pressure in system.
